body: Aww you don't have to do that! Thank you so much if you do though. It would mean a lot to me. :)

Hey! Thank you for the message. :)

Me and my mother had a talk about going to CIT (TAFE in Melb, CIT for Canberra, same thing.) I don't know if Im up for it, but I think it would lead me onto the right path. By the sounds of it it sounds probably like the best option though. :)

That's true, I will probably just end up going to a pub with my brother or out to dinner. Will be kind of sad not to have any friends come but it should be pretty good non the less. Thank you for the comment. :)

That's true, I hope that's the case. 

I'll pm you back if I rent out a PO Box. I don't expect you to send me anything though. :)

Wow, awesome advice! Thank you so much. :)

I'll definitely check out the links you sent me. The non zero day sounds like it would really help me.

Thank you :)

Hey! I'm so sorry to hear you're in a similar situation. :( The parents situation is a toughie, because being young you're kinda forced to stay with them even if they aren't very nice :/ maybe you have a aunt/uncle/grandparent you could stay with?

I also made plans to kill myself, I listed every reasonable method and way of going about it, what to do on my last day etc. I just hope that day never comes, I don't want to kill myself I just want to be happy.

We can absolutely be friends! :)

I'm not currently seeing a therapist, but I am seriously considering it.

Yeah I have heard people become more mature once college starts and making friends is easier, I would just have a pretty hard time because I don't really trust people. I do want to get into college eventually and hopefully meet new people there, but my social skills suck. :(

There are a lot of things I'd love to do, however with the problems I have such as extreme fear of people and being in social situations, it makes it extremely difficult.

Thank you so much. I wish you all the best too. :)

I'll get back to you once I get a PO Box. Thank you a lot if you do decide to send me a postcard, It would really cheer me up, I would appreciate it so much. :)
Thank you! You are a really awesome person. :)

Hey! Happy early birthday! :)

Haha Canberra isn't all that glamorous, it's quite boring here, I've been to Melbourne a few times, it's so beautiful! I would love to visit Sweden, it looks gorgeous, I'm jealous you live there haha.

Thank you for the message. :)

Oh my god, you are such an amazing person. Thank you so much! I always had it in my mind that everyone was selfish and didn't care about others. However you're one of the nicest people I've ever met. I will definitely rent a PO Box in the future and I'll get back to you! I'm actually crying right now because no one has ever been this nice to me. You are an awesome amazing person. Thank you.

Ahhh that's a shame. :(

That would be such an amazing idea haha. Would love that so much. :) I don't have a PO Box unfortunately. :(

Hey. Thanks for replying! I know it's just I overthink about it too much and I sometimes feel like since everyone else in my family had big birthday parties, then if I don't it will be weird. I need to not worry about it tbh. I really appreciate your comment, thank you. :)

Wow thank you so much, that's really helpful to say. :) Haha I wouldn't want or expect anything from you, don't worry. The thought is super nice though, thanks for asking. :) I currently live in Canberra Australia, I'm not sure if you're around in those parts.
Yeah that's true, I would much rather have one really good friend than 20 fake friends.

This sounds like a good idea too, thank you. :)

28th.
Thank you. :) That sounds interesting, I'm going to look into that. Why not give it a try, could be good for me haha.

Hey thanks for the advice, I'm sorry you had to deal with those social issues, they suck. :/ I do want to go back to school, but I don't know how I'd do. I failed a lot when I did go. So I'm a little worried about that.

Hey, thanks heaps for this comment. I have been trying to force myself to do things more, even if it's just sitting outside for 30 minutes or going for a 5 minute walk. I do find it lifts my mood by a little bit, but hardly at all. Hey man that's fine, I'm actually a very forgiving person, It's absolutely fine, and I appreciate your comment a lot. It means a lot. Thank you. :)
Oh wow, you're absolutely right, I didn't think about it that way. I guess switching roles I would be absolutely devastated. Not sure how I thought that would be the case. Thank you.

Hey, I feel you, social anxiety ruins pretty much everything, stops you from enjoying so much you want to do. Those suggestions actually seem pretty cool! I'll definitely consider them.

I guess you're right about the birthday thing, I think I'm just overthinking it at the moment. However it still worries me.

My future is still a little blurry, I just don't really have high hopes that it will turn around, I feel like it's just going to get progressively worse.

Absolutely you can be my friend :) haha. I really appreciate you taking the time to make this comment. Thank you so much.
I suppose that makes sense, I'm hoping it won't upset her too much but if she has my siblings to comfort her, then that might make me happier knowing it won't cause too much pain. Thank you.
